name: cadence
description: A band that keeps the chat in rhythm: auto effort per prompt (Haiku, Jev, or an offline decision model via Ollaya), context in tokens, prompt cache timer, rate limits, Haiku compaction with a safety net, and one-click handoff

language.title: Language
language.description: What the band, toasts and /cadence output are written in. Commands and option values stay in English.

contextBudget.title: Context budget (tokens)
contextBudget.description: The bar counts against this total, not the model window. Use the same value in CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW.

autoEffort.title: Auto effort
autoEffort.description: on: a fast judge picks the effort for each prompt. off: the app's effort applies.

judge.title: Effort judge
judge.description: auto: the local judge if localUrl is set, then Jev if a key is found, with Haiku always as fallback. haiku: only Haiku, through the session login. jev: TypeSafe's Jev (key). local: a decision model on your machine, offline (Ollaya).

localUrl.title: Local judge URL (optional)
localUrl.description: Ollaya: http://127.0.0.1:11435 (the default when empty). Any server with Jev's /v1/systemone works (Ollama 0.40+, laya-serve). A URL ending in /chat/completions sends a chat model through the OpenAI API instead.

localModel.title: Local judge model (optional)
localModel.description: The model the local server knows. Empty: laya:multilingual (CPU, reads Portuguese). With a NVIDIA GPU, winnow:e4b is Ollaya's recommended pick.

typesafeKey.title: TypeSafe key (optional)
typesafeKey.description: For the Jev judge. Without it, cadence looks for TYPESAFE_API_KEY and, with judge jev, ~/.config/jev/.env.

bias.title: Bias
bias.description: -2 cheaper to 2 more thorough. Only moves the calls where the judge was unsure.

compactWith.title: Who writes the compaction summary
compactWith.description: haiku: Haiku 5.5, much cheaper, with cadence's safety net. session: the chat model, as Claude Code does.

idleMinutes.title: Compact after idle (min)
idleMinutes.description: With no message and no agent work for this long, the chat compacts on its own. 0 turns it off.

idleMinTokens.title: Minimum to compact when idle (tokens)
idleMinTokens.description: Below this, idle compaction does not run.

heavyPct.title: Heavy context warning (%)
heavyPct.description: Shows the warning with Compact and New chat past this share of the budget.

afterHandoff.title: After handoff
afterHandoff.description: continue: clears and keeps going. wait: clears, says where things stand and waits. copy: keeps the chat and copies the handoff.

handoffAdvice.title: Suggest handoff
handoffAdvice.description: on: from 30% of the budget, Haiku says when a new chat would do better.

handoffSkill.title: Full handoff skill (optional)
handoffSkill.description: A skill or command that writes the full handoff. Empty: cadence checks git and writes HANDOFF.md.
